final: WITH channel_avgs AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) as ch_avg FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ch_avg) as ovr_avg FROM channel_avgs WHERE ch_avg IS NOT NULL), filtered_groups AS (SELECT ca.ch_avg, ca.ch_avg - oa.ovr_avg as diff FROM channel_avgs ca CROSS JOIN overall oa WHERE ca.ch_avg > oa.ovr_avg) SELECT AVG(ch_avg) as avg_of_group_avgs, AVG(diff) as avg_of_diffs FROM filtered_groups
